siteContent.announcement: Welcome to Mauli Farms! Current Season: Private Swimming Pool, Bonfire Nights & Peaceful Sahyadri Hill Stays.
siteContent.waterfallSeasonStatus: Monsoon Seasonal (Active July – Sept) · Private Pool & Freshwater Stream Year-Round
siteContent.templeNote: Vitthal Rukhmini Mandir: Sacred private temple inside our 1-acre property for quiet morning darshan and prayer.
siteContent.poolNote: Private 12×24 ft Swimming Pool with sun loungers, daily filtration, and scenic forest views.

deals.title: Weekend & Holiday Group Offer
deals.description: Book for 10 or more family & friends and enjoy a complimentary evening stone bonfire with barbecue grill setup, plus special packages for multi-night stays!
perks: Complimentary Evening Bonfire & Charcoal BBQ Setup
Private 12×24 ft swimming pool with spacious sun deck
Sacred Vitthal Rukhmini Mandir inside the 1-acre property
In-plot natural waterfall (monsoon seasonal) & freshwater stream
Home-cooked Maharashtrian feasts prepared fresh by caretakers
100% Gated 1-Acre Lawn for kids and pets to play safely

experiences.title: Swimming Pool & Sun Deck
experiences.description: Enjoy the private 12×24 ft swimming pool with daily filtration and wooden sun deck overlooking green hills.

experiences.title: Vitthal Rukhmini Mandir
experiences.description: Begin your day with peaceful morning prayers at our private in-plot temple surrounded by flowering trees.

experiences.title: In-Plot Waterfall (Seasonal) & Stream
experiences.description: Experience our cascading natural waterfall (active in monsoons) and year-round cool mountain stream running through the plot.

experiences.title: Family & Friends Stays
experiences.description: Relax together across spacious lawns, share home-cooked meals, and unwind in the large verandah.
experiences.highlight: Private farmhouse exclusively for your group

experiences.title: Bonfire & Movie Nights
experiences.description: Gather around the warm stone bonfire under the starlit sky, roast barbecue skewers, and watch movies on the lawn.

experiences.title: Maharashtrian Chulha Feasts
experiences.description: Savor authentic home-cooked Gavran chicken, pitla-bhakri, and local seasonal dishes prepared by caring in-house staff.
